result.rationale: Igneo confirms a June 4, 2026 completed preferred-equity investment under its North American strategy and still lists Pathway as a jointly governed Energy asset. Count Pathway Power LLC once; Holdings and project SPVs are not separate PortCos. No later transfer or exit was found.

identityResolution.holdcoTreatment: Pathway Power Holdings LLC issued Renova's notes within the same platform; no separate PortCo. Its relationship to LLC is NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
identityResolution.nameSupport: Pathway, AB CarVal and Igneo counsel use LLC; Igneo's 'LCC' is a typo.

owners.vehicle: North American strategy; legal vehicle NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED
owners.stake: Preferred equity; percentage NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED; joint governance

ownershipResolution.founderControl: The founders created Pathway and remain executives; their original/retained equity, votes and control are NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED. Igneo reports joint governance and a board seat.
financingInvestors: RENOVA: USD25m Dec-2023 convertible unsecured notes from Holdings; convertible after three years; ~25% only if converted; project rights up to 49%/1GW; no conversion found.
Forest Road/CenterNode: USD36m 2022 development loan/facility; no platform equity evidenced; current exposure NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
Rabobank: interconnection credit/LC facility closed 2024-11-04; lender/arranger.
AB CarVal-managed funds: USD150m senior-secured facility closed concurrently in Jun-2026; lender.

operatingResolution.scope: Utility-scale hybrid solar/BESS developer and IPP across five U.S. RTOs; Igneo highlights SPP/MISO.
operatingResolution.pipeline: Igneo: >1GW near-term plus ~1GW early-stage; AB CarVal: 13 projects/~3.2GWac; Pathway current site: 23 projects/>7GW in 13 states.
operatingResolution.Greenridge: Texas SPP, 150MW solar plus 150MW four-hour BESS; MOU-stage PPA, 2028 target COD. Renova's Aug-2026 unnamed matching minority project remained in development: FY2027 build/FY2028 COD, land and permits complete, grid/offtake pending; the match is not explicit.
operatingResolution.Foxtrot: Arkansas, 150MW four-hour BESS; MOU-stage tolling, 2027 target COD. No later direct construction/COD or exact-SPV evidence found.

acquisitionExitCheck.result: Igneo remained current. No platform/project sale, Igneo transfer/exit, Renova conversion, ownership-changing recapitalization or signed pending owner transfer was found.
